Gale of Nemesis

Legend · Passive

Skill by star

0★
Base skill
After the owner casts a skill proactively (including using skills to pursue and attack or counterattack), increases self Max HP by 10% for 1 turn. Also, grants self 1 layer of [Bloodflow]: Each layer additionally increases Max HP by 1% for 2 turns, stackable up to 10 layers.

  • Also, grants self 1 layer of [Bloodflow]: Each layer additionally increases Max HP by 1→2% for 2 turns, stackable up to 10 layers.

Full skill text at 5★
After the owner casts a skill proactively (including using skills to pursue and attack or counterattack), increases self Max HP by 30% for 1 turn. Also, grants self 1 layer of [Bloodflow]: Each layer additionally increases Max HP by 3% for 2 turns, stackable up to 10 layers. When the owner has a [Shield], reduces DMG taken by 40%. When the owner inflicts 5 layers of Attribute Debuffs or [HP Burning] in total, self gains [Wind Spirit]: Immune to the Control effect next time.
Full skill text at 7★
After the owner casts a skill proactively (including using skills to pursue and attack or counterattack), increases self Max HP by 30% for 1 turn. Also, grants self 1 layer of [Bloodflow]: Each layer additionally increases Max HP by 3% for 2 turns, stackable up to 10 layers. When the owner has a [Shield], reduces DMG taken by 40%. When the owner inflicts 5 layers of Attribute Debuffs or [HP Burning] in total, self gains [Wind Spirit]: Immune to the Control effect next time. When the owner casts skills to pursue and attack or counterattack, increases [HP Burning] DMG dealt by 40%. If the owner has the [HP Burning] tag and the highest initial HP among allies, after 2 of self turns, grants other allies [Wind Soul] (each stage of DMG taken does not exceed 25% of their Max HP) for 2 turns; meanwhile, the owner gains [Wind Soul] for 5 turns. This effect only takes effect once each wave.
Source: game files.

Effects

  • [Bloodflow] — Each layer increases Max HP by a certain amount.
  • [Shield] — Blocks some DMG.
  • [HP Burning] — Takes DMG by 8% of self Max HP (caps at 30% of the inflictor's Max HP) each turn before action, stackable up to 5 layers. HP Burning DMG ignores DEF and cannot trigger Crit, Leech and DMG Reflect effects.
  • [Wind Spirit] — Immune to the Control effect next time.
  • [Wind Soul] — Each stage of DMG taken does not exceed a certain amount of Max HP.
